name: packed-sdk-admission
goal: The packed verification SDK reports a missing coding verification record before loading optional compiler dependencies, with identical diagnostics in Bun and Node.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The packed consumer preserves its expected missing-verification-record diagnostic in Bun and Node. At f4dec89d13 the test now explicitly removes UI dependencies after install; it fails with Task evidence could not be read instead of the established diagnostic.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The CLI now declares Svelte, so asserting it absent immediately after install stopped the packaged SDK test before its behavior checks. Explicitly remove only the temporary consumer UI dependencies, retaining both the absence assertion and all public SDK expectations. This reveals eager compiler initialization before the missing-record check.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen packaged consumer at f4dec89d13 fails with Task evidence could not be read instead of the established missing-record error. Red record 0744cb974f0e2d04b01a8844536e7e884ca83dfc0f034a4e5b4547cd6492a40c retains the unchanged SDK assertions.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: At 5bb2ab76bdb00a4e8299f02bed17c52b5cbd519d, the real verification-record check now precedes dynamic compiler imports. Planning, source and missing-record diagnostics do not require Svelte. Valid coding records still use the existing evidence, scope and performance checks.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged packed-consumer assertions fail at f4dec89d13 and pass at 5bb2ab76b in Bun and Node. Records bab3e3bb88021a2b9b7335063637538bf27290189a778452d45cc33e5d3fe2b0 and d24fa38b1508122961c8f21d9509783fc8c26408de3272626c3deb2ff85b2bed preserve the paired full corpus and common environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
